user_requirements: Review REPORT.md — Absolute Security Group's 'Calls from Businesses' full-year report to Heart of the City (audience: Edward Caughey, Head of Customer Experience, for his BOARD report / KPI tracker). SOURCE_DATA.txt contains the underlying weekly figures the report is built from. This must be CLIENT-FOCUSED and VALUE-LED while remaining scrupulously accurate — a prior ASG document was queried by HOTC for one mis-attributed statistic, so unsupported claims are the highest-risk defect. Your job: (1) VERIFY every number — recompute each monthly total from the weekly figures in SOURCE_DATA.txt, the FY26 and FY25 grand totals, the like-for-like -11% (2,419 vs 2,707 over Aug-Jun), and the per-day 6.7 vs 8.1 — flag anything that does not reproduce. (2) Check the July 2025 partial-data handling is honest and clearly flagged (it must NOT be presented as a real decline). (3) Assess whether the report is genuinely client-focused and shows the service's value truthfully: the calls are DOWN ~11% year-on-year because FY26 runs reduced patrol coverage vs a larger FY25 budget — the report must present this honestly WITHOUT spin, but should surface the legitimate value angle (sustained high business engagement; calls-per-patrol/efficiency; the strong recent months Oct 302 / Dec 305 / Jun 265). Suggest the strongest HONEST value framing. (4) Flag any claim not supported by the data — especially the 'FY25 operated a larger patrol-coverage programme' line: is it substantiated, or does it need a coverage/budget figure to stand? (5) Assess tone for a board/KPI audience — factual, confident, not defensive, not over-promotional. (6) List concrete corrections with severity CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/PASS, the exact current text and the exact replacement text. Do NOT rewrite the report wholesale — produce the findings list.
acquirer_context: Absolute Security Group reports operational data to Heart of the City (Auckland CBD business association). Edward feeds this into a board report and a KPI tracker where 'Calls from Businesses' is framed as a utilisation/engagement measure indexed to a baseline of 100 (last quarter ~280 on that index — ASG does not hold the index definition and must not invent it). The report will be read by HOTC leadership and potentially their board. Honesty and defensibility outrank optics.
